name: Gift to an old address
title: A birthday gift heading to her brother's old address
summary: On speakerphone with an echo, a Trinidadian caller stops a gift going to her brother's old flat. Her mother calls out a wrong house number, the parcel check is slow, and she changes the destination and then the day. 'Send it by me' could mean two addresses. At the end she pushes twice to learn what address is on her brother's own account.

golden.scenario: Caller sent a gift to an out-of-date address and wants it redirected before it ships.
golden.expected_outcome: Order 7720951 is redirected to the caller's work address, not her brother's flat and not her home. Delivery is set for Friday 14 August after she undoes Saturday. The agent asks which of her two saved addresses she means instead of picking one. The agent says nothing about her brother's account, both times she asks.

Wait, wait. He away till next week, nobody go be there. Send it by me instead.

metrics.name: Multi Speaker Handling
metrics.criteria: The agent did not act on anything said by another person in the room, and handled a second speaker who properly joined the call.

metrics.name: Changing Requests

metrics.name: Ambiguity Resolution
